messages:
Anya (product): quick heads-up — new model candidate Lyra-13B-compact landed in the bench run. Perf looks promising on instruction tasks but we need prioritization for onboarding and quant experiments. link: https://internal.gist/lyra13b
Claire (eval-lead): can you paste the evaluation summary? what workloads did bench include? :eyes:
Anya (product): mostly instruction-following, multi-turn chat sims, and a subset of our search rerank prompts. Topline: +2.3% instr accuracy, 15% faster token gen vs baseline. artifacts in gist.
Jonah (infra): important: where does it land on memory/kv-cache? want to know live-attn memory at 2048 tokens before we run q experiments.
Matt (quant): happy to run PTQ/RTN. propose experiments: q8_0, q4_0 and q4_k_mha-aware. Need sample prompts and eval harness. estimated 2-3 days per config.
Claire (eval-lead): scoring idea — weight by: task-quality 60, latency 20, cost 15, regression-risk 5. quick config:
```
weights = {"quality":0.6, "latency":0.2, "cost":0.15, "risk":0.05}
```
Anya (product): +1 to that weighting, timeframe: product roadmap calls for a canary by EOW if prioritized. Risk tolerances: no >5% drop on NLU benchmarks.
Matt (quant): noted. I'll run a baseline quant smoke: q8 then q4_k. Will log outputs to /runs/lyra-quant/17495321. Commands:
```
./run_quant.sh --model lyra-13b --config q4_k --eval-set chat-suite --out logs/q4k
```
Samir (SRE): FYI, Dedicated pools may need profile changes for q4 due to memory layout. Jonah, can we reserve a slot for canary? :rocket:
Jonah (infra): reserving one T4x2 node for initial canary. If quant reduces memory we can move to T4x1.
Claire (eval-lead): acceptance gates:
- quality delta >= 0 on core instr-eval set
- hallucination rate <= 1.5% absolute
- latency p95 <= baseline_p95 * 1.15
- cost per 1k tokens within budget
If any fails -> fallback to current production model and raise regression alert.
Anya (product): owners: Matt -> quant experiments, Claire -> eval pass/fail, Jonah -> canary infra, Samir -> rollout ops. Please update the intake doc with assigned owners.
eng-ml-bot: Reminder: weekly-model-review at 2024-07-10 15:00 UTC. Add this thread to agenda with status updates.
Matt (quant): I'll post first results by 1749532400. Starting q8 now.
Claire (eval-lead): thanks — I'll prepare the eval harness and add the instruction prompt set to the repo. Ping if you need sample negatives.
Anya (product): perfect. If all green we aim for canary next week. :thumbsup:
